# Used only by scripts/test-usage-db.ts; no development volumes or fixed ports.
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: mailloop_test
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${MAILLOOP_TEST_PASSWORD:?Disposable runner required}
      POSTGRES_DB: mailloop_usage_test
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1::5432"
    tmpfs:
      - /var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U mailloop_test -d mailloop_usage_test"]
      interval: 1s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
